findings.title: Failure collection aborts on the condition it must preserve
findings.cause: Before failure_origin is saved, asserts require current exe/refs intact, beforefirst errors empty, all native0 helper error/timeout/cleanup successful and every result closure valid. A real input drift, native0 cleanup error or launcher error/NULL exit therefore causes a second unsealed exception.
findings.change: Separate best-effort original failure capture from success qualification. Keep actual outer/controller/native nullable values and helper fields; collect validation_errors and raw refs. Gate PASS on all checks, but always seal original failure and any sealer failure in a distinct immutable result. Do not coerce unsupported exit/NULL to 1 or 0.

findings.title: Failed attempted case incorrectly represented as later NOT_RUN; MODEL total can omit its calls
findings.cause: runner.results is appended only after all post-fixture gates. failure.not_run is roster minus qualified results, so it includes an already attempted native case. MODEL sum in sealer uses qualified results only and misses HTTP calls in that attempted case.
findings.change: Derive separate QUALIFIED, ATTEMPTED_FAILED_OR_UNQUALIFIED, NEVER_STARTED partitions from exact roster, existing case/process records and argv. Preserve original not_run verbatim as runner_unqualified_roster, not later_NOT_RUN. Publish qualified_MODEL separately; failed-case observed records plus coverage/unknown establish total, otherwise actual_total=NULL with known lower bound. external_paid_calls_authorized=0 is distinct from observed0; no inferred actual_cost=0.

findings.title: Bind sealing inputs and success summary to frozen spec and exact case/process mapping
findings.cause: Spec is loaded by hardcoded path but its bytes are not compared with grant.spec_sha256/prepared.spec. Success checks only final status strings and global counts; it does not compare final result.results/MODEL/snapshots with collected case records or bind each invocation argv/process folder uniquely to the roster.
findings.change: Verify spec actual bytes against grant and prepared pins, source/output/work/roster grant equality and runner SHA. Enforce unique ordered path identities in vectors and case-to-process bijection including exe/selector argv. Compare complete final aggregate to collected results and counts. Verify outer stdout/stderr pinned refs and keep wrapper_error separate.
